runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 13:57 sweep. Eleven independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, public Facebook indexing and broad public company-career discovery. Profesia surfaced detect s.r.o. System Administrator in Bratislava at 2,000 EUR/month, but it is a senior/system-administration mismatch and was rejected. Upwork surfaced a WooCommerce Product Listing & Upload Specialist at 10-30 USD/hour, worldwide remote, but it is three weeks old with 20-50 proposals, 1 hire and 4 interviews; it remains below promotion threshold. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Marketplace response-probability decay
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: For freelance listings, combine listing age, proposals, hires, interviews and client last-viewed recency into a response-probability decay score; suppress jobs where good skill fit is outweighed by near-zero practical reply odds.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Support vs sysadmin scope classifier
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Classify IT roles by actual operational scope rather than title keywords: L1 endpoint/user support stays eligible, while server/network ownership, complex infrastructure administration and mentoring responsibilities trigger a strong seniority/skills penalty.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data was attempted.
